## Key Shipped Projects
- [Yulya — Discord AI Companion](https://discord.yulya.me): Real-time voice companion with custom personas, persistent vector memory, WebRTC, and in-server simulated crypto economy.
- [Yulya Studio](https://studio.yulya.me): AI-assisted browser game studio for writing, running, and remixing games with sandboxed simulation.
- [LEARNEXA 2.0](https://github.com/moheith/LEARNEXA-2.0): Skill-exchange marketplace matching students through TF-IDF algorithms built on Flask and Next.js.
- [Yulya Models](https://huggingface.co/moheith): Family of 8 fine-tuned conversational language models published on Hugging Face and Ollama.
- [Desktop AI Companion](https://github.com/moheith/desktop-ai-companion): Overlay desktop assistant with conversational memory.
- [Textlink](https://github.com/moheith/Treasure): Serverless, database-free ephemeral text-to-URL encoding tool.
- [Yulya API](https://github.com/moheith/Yulya-API): High-throughput FastAPI embedding microservice.
